description:
Gap in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot PR #86, merged 4e518548. downstream/controller.py permission_gaps correctly detects excess installation permissions, but readiness records installation permissions successful whenever required permissions are present and puts excess permissions only in warnings. The final ready calculation ignores warnings. Reproduced against merged code with the exact intended permission set plus administration:write: readiness returned ready=True and a warning. Enabled publishing therefore proceeds despite broader privileges than the configured fork-only least-privilege boundary. The App JWT already supplies full installation permissions, so this is not a limitation of downscoped token inspection.

Change in the fork: make readiness fail for grants outside the intended permission set and for higher levels on allowed permissions. Treat GitHub mandatory metadata read and any documented no-access values appropriately. Report the excess grants clearly and keep credentials isolated; no automatic App reconfiguration.
